title: Ootle Bounty
creator: Cape
summary: MIT-licensed bug-bounty escrow template source with a walletless browser simulation. Researchers submit report commitments and sponsors decide validity; accepted findings draw from a proposed locked pool. The model cannot force honest sponsor triage or detect reworded duplicate reports. The browser uses a temporary demo encryption key, not a production key-management system, and sends no real funds. The recording shows the README and documented template methods. No deployed network contract is established by these sources.
cardSummary: Explore bug-bounty pools, report commitments, sponsor triage and payouts through Rust source and a walletless browser simulation.
